**What's the idea?**
A clear description of the feature or improvement.

**What problem does it solve?**
Why would this be useful? What are you trying to do?

**How might it work?**
Any thoughts on the UI/behaviour, if you have them.

**Anything else?**
Mockups, examples from other apps, or extra context.
